results.title: Harish Rao demands rollback of salary cuts for municipal outsourcing staff
results.description: BRS leader T Harish Rao criticised the Telangana government over salary cuts for municipal outsourcing employees, demanding withdrawal of the orders and protection of existing pay. He said 31,000 employees and their families would face a severe financial burden.

results.title: Xi arrives for BRICS summit, Congress pushes PM Modi to raise Arunachal issue
results.description: Ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to India for the BRICS Summit 2026, AICC General Secretary and Assam in-charge Bhupesh Baghel questioned whether Prime Minister Narendra Modi would raise sensitive issues concerning Arunachal Pradesh and the Galwan clash during his talks with the Chinese leader.

results.title: Jarange Patil to begin indefinite hunger strike in Mumbai from Sept 19
results.description: Activist Manoj Jarange announced an indefinite hunger strike in Mumbai from September 19 for Maratha reservation in jobs and education. He will lead a march from September 15, covering various districts before reaching Azad Maidan. Jarange urged peaceful protest and accused the government of inaction on caste certificates, while the Bombay High Court upheld the right to protest. The core demand is for Marathas to be included in the OBC category via Kunbi records, a move opposed by existing OBC groups.
